title: madhuca pachyphylla
intro: Madhuca pachyphylla, commonly known as the "Butter Tree" due to its large, yellow flowers, is a species of flowering plant native to the tropical forests of India. This tree is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, helping to reduce fever and alleviate respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Madhuca pachyphylla include its ability to act as an analgesic, anti-diarrheal, and anti-bacterial agent. The bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids, tannins, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
